# SetSamplerAddressModeV <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetSamplerAddressModeV:Void sampler:Int32, mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | In | Int32 | required | The sampler to change. |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | The address mode, 0 to 3. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Chooses what is read where the vertical texture coordinate (v) is not between 0 and 1. The modes are the ones of [SetSamplerAddressModeU](SetSamplerAddressModeU): 0 repeat, 1 mirror, 2 clamp, 3 border ([SetSamplerBorderColor](SetSamplerBorderColor)). This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.

## Differences

* The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error.
